VORELLIA / THE DETAILS

Privacy policy

A clear explanation of what happens to your information on this website.

Updated November 5, 2026

Who this notice is about

Vorellia is a creative brand operated by Karim El Moussadeq in Ontario, Canada. Vorellia works with clients in Canada, Morocco and other countries. This notice explains how information is handled through the Vorellia website.

Booking a conversation

The site does not operate an inquiry form. When you choose to book a call, the site loads Calendly and you enter the information needed to schedule a meeting. Calendly processes that information under its own notices, including its privacy policy.

Website delivery and technical information

Netlify and other infrastructure providers may process technical information such as IP address, browser information and request logs to deliver and protect the website. Vorellia does not currently use Google Analytics, advertising pixels, embedded social feeds, a contact form or a newsletter platform.

External links

The Instagram link opens an external platform. Instagram’s terms and privacy practices apply after you leave this site.

Privacy requests

You can request access, correction or deletion of information held by Vorellia by emailing hello@vorellia.com. We may need to verify the request and may retain limited information where the law permits or requires it. Information entered directly into Calendly is handled according to Calendly’s own retention and privacy practices.

International clients and processing

Because Vorellia works internationally and relies on service providers, information may be processed in Canada or other countries where those providers operate. The relevant provider notices describe their safeguards and handling practices.

Security and updates

The site uses HTTPS and reasonable measures are taken to protect the website. No online service can guarantee complete security. This notice will be updated when the information practices or service providers change.

Questions, privacy requests, deletion requests and accessibility feedback can be sent to hello@vorellia.com.
